brandConfig.heading: Brand configuration
brandConfig.description: Your brand bible. These values shape every AI-generated blog post, alt text, and future content — and accumulate learnings from your edits over time.

placeholders.toneOfVoice: How the brand communicates (e.g. formal, casual, inspirational). Use 'Scrape store' to auto-generate from your content.
placeholders.benchmarks: Competitor or reference brands (e.g. Gisou, Glossier), one per line
placeholders.editorialGuidelines: Content architecture, tone rules, structure guidelines
placeholders.formatRecommendations: HTML structure, summary guidelines (e.g. Resumo HTML: 150–160 chars), content length

scrapeStore.heading: Scrape store
scrapeStore.description: Use "Scrape store" to analyze your shop content and auto-generate tone of voice. Requires the Content Scraper API to be configured.

export.heading: Export
export.description: Your brand bible as a portable artifact. Download and reuse elsewhere.

learnings.heading: Learned from edits
learnings.empty: No learnings yet. Review AI drafts on the Blog Posts tab to start.

toneSummary.heading: Tone of voice
toneSummary.title: Brand voice evidence base
toneSummary.stats: The AI infers your brand voice from these sources: {{traits}} validated tone trait{{traitPlural}}, {{learnings}} edit-correction{{learningPlural}}, {{toneState}}, language {{language}}.

sources.heading: Connected sources
sources.description: We sample copy from these sources weekly to learn how your brand sounds. Every new batch is reviewed by you before it changes how blog posts are written.

rows.shopifyDetailIdle: Ready to sample your existing blog articles.
rows.metaDetailIdle: Connect to pull captions + image text via Meta Graph API.
rows.mondayDetailIdle: Add API key + board IDs to sample internal copy.
rows.manualDetailIdle: Brandbooks, manifestos, or any reference document.

shopify.help: Auto-connected via your Shopify session — no credentials needed. We sample up to 5 blogs × 25 most recent articles.

manual.emptyHint: No references yet. Drop a file or paste a URL above to add one.

monday.title: Monday.com configuration
monday.description: Generate an API key in Monday.com (Profile → Admin → API). Paste your board IDs comma-separated.

meta.title: Instagram & Facebook configuration
meta.description: Generate a long-lived Page Access Token in Meta Business Suite (Settings → Users → System Users → Generate token). Provide the IG Business ID and/or FB Page ID for accounts you want sampled.

upload.title: Add a brandbook, manifesto, or any reference
upload.sub: PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD up to 30MB · or paste a URL

manualOverride.title: Manual override (always wins)
manualOverride.empty: No manual tone string set. Add one on Brand settings to override the inferred tone.

pending.empty: No hypotheses pending. Run a refresh to sample your sources and infer traits.
